identitySignals: Name matches the City of Oakland Head Start program, run by the City of Oakland Human Services Department (oaklandca.gov)

The program provides early childhood education and care in Oakland for children from birth to age five, matching OUSD's Early Childhood Education Department subcontract with the City of Oakland for child development funding

The agenda item cites a City of Oakland resolution (No. 2122-0105) and FY 2021-2022 Head Start funding, and the City's Head Start/Early Head Start program received a new grant in FY 2021-22 (search result summarizing City of Oakland Head Start materials)
research.notes: Program of the City of Oakland Human Services Department (a public agency), not a separate legal entity, so no EIN, CA entity number or UEI is given. Page does not mention OUSD.

profile.address: 150 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza, Suite 5352, Oakland, CA 94612
profile.summary: The City of Oakland Head Start program offers free early care and education for children from birth to age five, along with prenatal education and family services, for eligible low-income Oakland families. Services are provided in center-based classrooms, through weekly home visits, and with licensed family child care providers. The program is run by the City of Oakland.

sources.title: Apply to Early Childhood and Family Services Options

review.notes: The agenda item is a subcontract with the City of Oakland (Resolution 2122-0105, Head Start, Early Childhood Education Dept), and the profile describes the City of Oakland's Head Start / Early Childhood and Family Services program. The cited page confirms the contact details, ages, and delivery types. The 'free' and 'prenatal education' claims appear on the parent Head Start page (oaklandca.gov/.../Head-Start-and-Early-Head-Start), not the cited sub-page, but are accurate and neutral. The cited page does not name the Human Services department in the summary, and the summary does not claim it.
